purpose: Synthetic behavior invariants derived from the supplied validation. These are expectations, not results for the finalized skill or live tickets.

procedure: Give the evaluator the finalized skill and raw fixture case only. Keep this expectations file and prior conclusions hidden until the response is captured.
Use only supplied synthetic observations. Do not access fixture URLs or perform repository, tracker, deployment, or other external actions.

For readiness requests, record criterion fulfillment, material premises and blockers, relationship certainty, next action with owner, coverage, and validity. For other requests, identify the appropriate route without adding a readiness review.
Compare the captured response with each expected behavior and its required supporting sources. Check decisions and evidence rather than wording, headings, or a numeric readiness score.
Record case-level results and any unsafe start recommendation separately. Synthetic success does not establish live access, installed discovery, source freshness, or host compatibility.

expected_behavior: Recognize already satisfied staging behavior using matching code, targeted verification and deployment evidence.
Do not treat age, the open tracker state, or the merge alone as completion evidence.
Recommend recognition of completion without implementation or automatic closure.
Mark the deployed-M42 premise contradicted rather than merely unverified.
Identify an evidenced prerequisite from SYN-202 to SYN-201 and its rollout/backfill completion condition.
Recommend sequencing and correction of the stale premise; do not begin dependent implementation or apply the migration.

cases.coverage: Hidden downstream schema effect / duplicate pending work / suspected keyword hit
expected_behavior: Find the evidenced producer/consumer consequence for SYN-302 even without an explicit ticket link.
Identify SYN-303 and PR 31 as overlapping pending work, not completed implementation.
Separate the SYN-330 keyword hit from the evidenced relationships; do not invent a dependency.
Treat compatibility/coordination as a material owner choice and withhold a start recommendation until resolved.

cases.coverage: No related tickets / age-only false positive
expected_behavior: Recommend implementation can start for the specified local CLI scope on current confirmed evidence.
Retain the negative search boundary, including other projects not searched.
Do not invent related tickets, declare global independence, widen the backlog scan, or mark the ticket obsolete because of age.
Keep the production-version premise unverified; the undated note is insufficient.
Report the disabled flag as observed, while preserving unknown applicability and production completion.
Recommend obtaining the authorized current production-version observation before implementation; do not route around denied access.
Retain inaccessible upgrade-ticket coverage and do not conclude no dependencies exist.

cases.coverage: Partly complete / pending review and deployment
expected_behavior: Identify staging expiry as satisfied and single use as unsatisfied.
Do not equate passing tests on the open PR with deployed completion.
Sequence security review/merge/deployment of the existing work instead of restarting completed work or producing a duplicate implementation.
Distinguish version availability from explicit production-adoption approval.
Preserve the current owner hold and identify the approval decision as blocking.
Do not label the work obsolete, satisfied, or ready merely because version 4 shipped.
Route the supplied PR/spec/standards review to code-review.
Do not add a ticket-readiness workflow to a request whose target is an existing change.

cases.coverage: Ticket and source drift / current verdict validity
expected_behavior: Invalidate any start recommendation based on ticket r2 and the initial repository head after both change.
Preserve a captured historical observation but do not claim it reviews the current r3/head.
Recommend re-reading the revised ticket and new head; unknown current evidence prevents starting.
Recognize the custom-forwarder request as superseded by the accepted owner decision, not merely by different code.
Link the evidenced replacement SYN-1002 and retain its unfinished status.
Do not rebuild the retired component, close the ticket, or silently implement the replacement under the readiness-review request.

cases.coverage: Uncommitted work / active assignment / same-head diff drift
expected_behavior: Keep the requested JSON main-branch behavior unsatisfied; uncommitted passing checks do not establish landed completion, while the existing CSV baseline may be recorded as a satisfied portion.
Identify SYN-1102 as evidenced overlapping active work even though no PR exists; reconcile the assignment before another implementation.
Treat changed worktree digest as invalidating the prior candidate check even with unchanged HEAD.
Keep the revised candidate content and default-CSV behavior unverified; obtain the current diff/checks and owner disposition before recommending a new start.
